verses.text: For the one directing. Of the servant of YHWH, of David. An utterance Of the transgression of the wicked [is] within my heart; there is no dread of God before his eyes.

segments.text: For the one directing. Of the servant of YHWH, of David. An utterance Of the transgression of the wicked [is] within my heart; there is no dread of God before his eyes.

verses.text: For he is flattering to himself in his own eyes, having found his iniquity to be hated.

segments.text: For he is flattering to himself in his own eyes, having found his iniquity to be hated.

verses.text: The words of his mouth [are] wickedness and deceit; he has ceased to be prudent and do good.

segments.text: The words of his mouth [are] wickedness and deceit; he has ceased to be prudent and do good.

verses.text: He devises iniquity upon his bed; he stands himself on a path [that is] not good; he does not reject evil.

segments.text: He devises iniquity upon his bed; he stands himself on a path [that is] not good; he does not reject evil.

verses.text: O YHWH, Your loving devotion [is] into the heavens, Your faithfulness as far as the clouds.

segments.text: O YHWH, Your loving devotion [is] into the heavens, Your faithfulness as far as the clouds.

verses.text: Your righteousness [is] like the mountains of Might, Your ordinances the great deep; You keep safe man and beast, O YHWH.

segments.text: Your righteousness [is] like the mountains of Might, Your ordinances the great deep; You keep safe man and beast, O YHWH.

verses.text: How precious [is] Your loving devotion, O God! Even the sons of man take refuge under the shadow of Your wings.

segments.text: How precious [is] Your loving devotion, O God! Even the sons of man take refuge under the shadow of Your wings.

verses.text: They are filled from the fatness of Your house, and You let them drink [from] the stream of Your delights.

segments.text: They are filled from the fatness of Your house, and You let them drink [from] the stream of Your delights.

verses.text: For with You [is] the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.

segments.text: For with You [is] the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.

verses.text: Draw out Your loving devotion to those knowing You, and Your righteousness to the upright of heart.

segments.text: Draw out Your loving devotion to those knowing You, and Your righteousness to the upright of heart.

verses.text: Do not let the foot of pride come against me, and the hand of the wicked, do not let it drive me away.

segments.text: Do not let the foot of pride come against me, and the hand of the wicked, do not let it drive me away.

verses.text: There the workers of iniquity do fall! They have been cast down, and are not able to rise.

segments.text: There the workers of iniquity do fall! They have been cast down, and are not able to rise.
